overall_reason: A design-tool site with a real token kit (ks- components, --spacing-xs to 3xl, radius tokens), but its own rules retype those tokens hundreds of times and run two ink vocabularies, and the chrome mixes small radii of 3, 5 and 6px.

score.reason: As a design-system site everything weighs more: T-HARDCODE fails on 400 spacing and 59 radius literals equal to tokens (TOK-006), T-TOKEN-TIERS on parallel --ks-ink and --color-ink roles (TOK-007), and T-SCALE-FIT on a second spacing base (TOK-002).

findings.evidence: declarations.literal_retypes_a_token_value: spacing 400, radius 59, font size 22, colour 5. Samples: .ks-section padding 56px, .ks-section-head gap 14px and margin-bottom 56px, .ks-button gap 12px, .ks-pill and .ks-icon-button radius 999px beside --ks-radius-pill, .ks-button font-size 15px. Spacing declarations are 82% literal.
findings.before: The site's own kit types the values its tokens hold
findings.after: Kit components read --spacing-*, --ks-radius-* and the type tokens
findings.why: A kit that retypes its tokens cannot be re-themed from the tokens, which is what it teaches.
findings.root: ks- kit rules written with literals

findings.evidence: tokens.most_referenced: --ks-ink (154 uses) and --color-ink (103) for the same ink role; --ks-paper-raised (88), --c-surface and --color-cream for surfaces; --color-mist (91 uses) and --color-charcoal are value-named roles. Tiers guess 129 'other' of 251.
findings.before: Two ink vocabularies and value-named roles in a design-system site
findings.after: One role vocabulary (ink, surface, rule, muted) with the --color-* names aliased to it
findings.why: Two names for one role split every future change.

findings.evidence: values.1440.spacing has 46 values, share on 4px 0.68 and best base 6; the most frequent are 14 (296), 10 (229) and 18 (221) beside 8, 12 and 16. The off_scale_spacing sweep lists 3, 5, 7, 9, 11, 13, 15, 17, 18, 22, 23 and 25px.
findings.before: A 4px token scale and a second rhythm on 7 and 9px multiples
findings.after: One base; snap 14, 18 and 10 to the --spacing steps or add them as steps
findings.why: Two rhythms side by side make paddings drift between sections.

findings.where: skip link, command console keys and intent chips, testimonial cards; 1440
findings.evidence: values.1440.radius has 10 values: 8 (93, testimonial cards), 3 (88), full, 6 (console keys), 1, 5 (intent chips), 2, 12, 4, 18; shadow has 14 recipes with 7 one-offs.
findings.why: Control radii a pixel apart read as rounding noise.

findings.before: Layers typed per rule up to 10000

strengths: Colour declarations are 90% var() over a semantic layer, including category roles with bg, border and text triples (--cat-create-bg, --cat-create-border, --cat-create-text).
The kit names its radii and spacing steps (--ks-radius-sm, --ks-radius-md, --spacing-xs to --spacing-3xl).
not_investigated: The page shows before-and-after demos and slop specimens on purpose; the table left 106 exhibit elements out, but other demos (hero proof canvas, hotel mock-up) remain in its counts, so the 26 font sizes and some spacing values are partly exhibit values.
T-THEME-PARITY: no second theme in the readable CSS.
One stylesheet was unreadable and 25 requests were blocked.
Visitor mode inferred as Persuade for a design-system product, held to its own tokens; no contract.
T-SYSTEM-DRIFT: no contract and no supplied design system or token file, so drift from a system could not be judged.
Inline style attributes: the DOM records computed styles, not which rule or inline style set a value.
Token source files (Sass, JSON token files, Figma variables) behind the shipped CSS were not available.
States the capture did not open (hover, focus, open menus, dialogs): their values were not in the table.
